prompt:
Pin-jointed steel lattice tower (space truss), millimetres. Levels k = 0..6 at z = 2000 k; at each level four corner nodes Nk0..Nk3 at (x, y) = (-b,-b), (b,-b), (b,b), (-b,b) with half-width b = 1000 - 500 z/12000 (tapering from 1000 at the base to 500 at the top). Members: legs Nk_i-N(k+1)_i (area 2000 mm^2); one face diagonal per face and panel, from Nk_i to N(k+1)_j for even k and from Nk_j to N(k+1)_i for odd k, with j = i+1 mod 4 (800 mm^2); ring members N(k+1)_i-N(k+1)_j (800 mm^2); one plan diagonal N(k+1)0-N(k+1)2 at every level above the base (800 mm^2). 78 members. E = 200000 MPa. The four base nodes N00..N03 are pinned (all translations fixed). Loads: at each top node N60..N63, 20 kN in +x and 50 kN downward (-z). Small displacements, linear elastic.
Report: the x-displacement of node N62, the largest member tension and the largest member compression (magnitudes).
JSON keys: ux_N62_mm, max_tension_kN, max_compression_kN.

Eight-storey shear building idealised as a lumped-mass chain: floor masses from floor 1 (bottom) to floor 8 (top) = 42, 40, 40, 38, 38, 36, 34, 30 tonnes; storey lateral stiffnesses from storey 1 (ground to floor 1) to storey 8 = 62, 58, 55, 52, 48, 44, 40, 35 MN/m. The ground is fixed; floors move only horizontally; no damping.
Report the first three natural frequencies in Hz.
JSON keys: f1_Hz, f2_Hz, f3_Hz.

Two-bay one-storey rigid-jointed steel frame in the x-y plane, millimetres and newtons. Column bases A (0,0), C (8000,0), E (14000,0) are fully fixed (clamped). Column tops B (0,5000), D (8000,5000), F (14000,5000). Columns AB, CD, EF: I = 8.36e7 mm^4, A = 7.8e3 mm^2. Beams BD and DF: I = 2.3e8 mm^4, A = 9.9e3 mm^2. E = 210000 MPa. In-plane behaviour only (no out-of-plane or lateral-torsional buckling). Vertical loads (downward) at the column tops: B 400 kN, D 900 kN, F 500 kN. Find the elastic critical load factor: the smallest multiplier of this whole load set at which the frame buckles (linear eigenvalue buckling, including axial shortening of the members).
JSON key: critical_load_factor.

family: steady heat conduction with convection (2D fin)
prompt:
Thin aluminium cooling fin: an L-shaped plate in the x-y plane made of the rectangles 0 <= x <= 100, 0 <= y <= 40 mm and 0 <= x <= 40, 0 <= y <= 100 mm (arms 40 mm wide), thickness 2 mm, thermal conductivity 200 W/(m K). The whole edge x = 0 (0 <= y <= 100 mm) is held at 100 C. Every other edge and both large faces lose heat by convection, h = 25 W/(m^2 K), to air at 20 C. Steady state; temperature uniform through the thickness. Report the heat flow entering through the edge x = 0 and the lowest temperature in the fin.
JSON keys: heat_flow_W, min_temperature_C.
